Index Tree Skip Style Theme
OldAnnotation - Annotation Type in p
Javadoc 8 through 16 wrote "annotation in".
NewAnnotation - Annotation Interface in p
Javadoc 17 and later write "annotation interface in".
SomeClass - Class in p
A class. Javadoc also writes "class in" for records and for exceptions.
SomeType - Class in p
A class or interface.
OldEnum - Enum in p
Javadoc 8 through 16 wrote "enum in".
NewEnum - Enum Class in p
Javadoc 17 and later write "enum class in".
SomeInterface - Interface in p
An interface.
T - Type parameter in p.SomeClass
A type parameter is deliberately not indexed.
p - package p
A package summary link has no "title" attribute, so it is not indexed.
